setup: Lie on your side, forearm under your shoulder
Lift your hips into a straight line
execution: Lower your hips slowly toward the floor
Drive your hips back up to the line
Push the floor away with your forearm
faults: Don't let your hips roll forward
Don't drop and bounce off the floor

notes: Keep the elbow directly under the shoulder so the shoulder stays stacked and supported.
Use a mat under the forearm and hip.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move

regressions.name: Side plank
regressions.reason: Hold the top position without the dips.

regressions.name: Bent-knee side plank hip dip
regressions.reason: Knees bent and on the floor; a much shorter lever.

progressions.name: Star side plank hip dip
progressions.reason: Top leg raised and support on the hand; much harder balance and hip work.

progressions.name: Copenhagen plank
progressions.reason: Side plank with the top leg on a bench; adds inner-thigh demand.

substitutions.name: Cable side bend
substitutions.reason: Loaded side-bending, easy to progress on a stack.

substitutions.name: Pallof press
substitutions.reason: Standing obliques work that resists twisting.

substitutions.name: Farmer's carry
substitutions.reason: Trunk and hips stay level while walking under load.

guideBrief.cameraNote: View facing the front of the body, camera at hip height, so the straight head-to-feet line and the hips dipping toward the floor read clearly. Supporting forearm nearest the floor.

keyPositions.label: Top
keyPositions.describe: Side plank on the lower forearm, elbow under the shoulder. Feet stacked, body straight from head to heels, hips lifted in line.

keyPositions.label: Dip
keyPositions.describe: Hips lowered toward the floor so the body bends sideways at the waist, hip just short of touching. Shoulder still stacked over the elbow, no forward roll.

ikHints: Forearm and feet stay fixed on the floor
emphasise: Hips move straight down and up, not forward
Body returns to a straight line at the top
